name: Venomborn
body:
Venomborn are the product of an insidious snake cult. They worship at the altar of evil serpent-gods, practicing ritualistic torture and humanoid sacrifice. Once humanoid themselves, they ingest special venomous tinctures as part of occult rituals to warp their flesh into something serpentine.

Physical

The mystic mutagen that all venomborn must drink warps them in unexpected ways, making each snake-like but in different ways. Some change very little; these are humanoid in shape with lightly serpentine features such as scaled skin, serpentine eyes, fangs, and forked tongues—and at a glance, they may even pass for human.

Others undergo radical changes, with some having their heads transform into snake heads, their legs merge into snake-like tails, or in the most extreme cases, their entire bodies transforming completely into giant snakes.

Social

While the species breeds true, they reproduce slowly and must induct new members of the cult to keep their numbers robust. Venomborn are oviparous; their young are born humanoid with only a subtle resemblance to snakes. Regardless of whether the venomborn was born into the life or recruited, they must drink the venom sometime after adolescence—a process that leads to painful physical and mental mutation, while also awakening their full mystic potential.

Venomborn culture is organized around death and cruelty. Settlements are hidden deep in the jungle or underground, and all feature a central temple where a steady supply of humanoid sacrifices are offered to the venomborn’s dark gods.

All venomborn are extremely devout to the furtherance of their species, although this is also usually balanced by their own individual ambitions. Internal intrigue is rampant as they jockey for position trying to prove their worth to the leaders of the cult.

Yet their loyalty to each other is unimpeachable when preserving the secrets of the cult itself.

Those venomborn most skilled at spycraft frequently infiltrate human and other humanoid settlements to abduct prisoners to serve as slaves, converts, and sacrifices.

The prefer magic, poison, and deception to direct confrontation, but are skilled at combat when it is required.

Alignment And Religion

Almost all venomborn are Evil in the extreme, while most are Neutral in matters of Law and Chaos. Their pantheon of serpent gods are usually depicted as a single knotted coil of vipers, and only the venomborn know the names, lore, and prayers associated with each of them.

Core Traits
Ability Score Modifiers Venomborn have varied ancestries and respond differently to the venomborn mutagen. You gain a +2 species bonus to one ability score of your choice [adaptable]. (0)
Size As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size. (0)
Type You are a Monstrous Humanoid with the augmented humanoid subtype. (3)
Speed Your base speed is 30 feet. (0)
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Venomborn. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Abyssal, Draconic, Goblin, Grippli, Infernal, and any human tongue. (0)
Other Traits
Darkvision You have darkvision 60 feet. (—)
Poison Resistance You gain a species bonus on saving throws against poison effects equal to your Hit Dice. (3)
Speak with Snakes You can use speak with animals as a spell-like ability at will, using your character level as your caster level, but only to speak with snakes. (1)
Toxic A number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day), you can envenom a weapon that you wield with your toxic saliva or blood (using blood requires you to be injured when you use this ability). Applying venom in this way is a swift action. (1)
Venomborn Venom: Injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Dex; cure 1 save.
Mutations Different venomborn react to the venomborn mutagen differently. Select two abilities from the following list to represent the abilities gained from your transformation. You cannot select the same mutation more than once. (5)
Charming: You can use charm animal (snakes only) and charm person once per day each as spell-like abilities. Your character level is your caster level, and Charisma is your casting ability.
Fangs: You have a set of sharp fangs that can inflict a vicious bite. Your bite is a primary natural weapon that deals 1d4 damage. If you have the toxic species trait, you can envenom your fangs as a swift action.
Infiltrator: You can use disguise self at will as a spell-like ability to appear human. Your appearance is always the same when you use this ability.
Legless: You have the lower body of a snake. You do not have legs and cannot be tripped.
Scaly: You have thick scales that provide a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.
Scent: Your forked tongue is especially sensitive to odors, giving you the scent B1 universal monster ability.
Spell Resistance: You gain spell resistance equal to 6 + your character level.
Swim: You have a swim speed of 20 feet and gain the +8 species bonus on Swim checks that a swim speed normally grants.
Total: 13 RP (advanced)
Favored Class Bonuses
Alchemist Add +1/4 to your natural armor bonus when using your mutagen.
Antipaladin Add +1/4 to the number of cruelties you can inflict.
Bard Add +1/6 to the number of people you can affect with the fascinate bardic performance.
Bloodrager Add +1/2 on critical hit confirmation rolls for attacks made with unarmed strikes or natural weapons (maximum bonus of +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Brawler Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a grapple or trip attempt.
Cleric Add +1/2 to negative energy spell damage, including inflict spells.
Fighter Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a grapple or trip attempt.
Hunter Add a +1/2 bonus on wild empathy checks to influence snakes and snake-like animals and magical beasts.
Inquisitor Add +1/2 to your effective inquisitor level for the purpose of determining the effects of one type of judgment.
Investigator Gain a +1/3 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using studied combat (maximum bonus +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Magus Gain +1/6 of a new magus arcana.
Mesmerist Increase painful stare’s damage by +1/4 point.
Monk Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a grapple attempt, and add +1/3 to the number of stunning attacks you can attempt per day.
Ninja Gain +1/6 of a new ninja trick.
Ranger Add a +1/2 bonus on wild empathy checks to influence snakes and snake-like animals and magical beasts.
Rogue Gain a +1/2 bonus on Bluff checks to feint and a +1/2 bonus on Diplomacy checks to gain information.
Sorcerer Add +1 to the total number of rounds per day you can use the claws abyssal bloodline power or the serpent’s fang serpentine bloodline power. You must possess the applicable power to select these bonuses.
